title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: the signed declaration, its lead time and the late-acceptance deadline
content:
## Signature starts review
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, review starts only once the shipper has signed the declaration, which only the shipper can do; an unsigned or returned declaration never starts review. The start of review takes the application from submitted to under review. Whether a signed declaration exists is read from the acceptance's declaration file on the line's records.

## On time and late
A declaration is on time when it is signed no later than the category's declaration lead time, in calendar days, before the booking's scheduled departure (ETD). A declaration signed after that point is late.

## Late-acceptance deadline
A late declaration is accepted only when it is signed no later than the category's late-acceptance hours before the cargo cut-off of the booking's sailing. The acceptance deadline is the cargo cut-off time less the category's cut-off hours, counted as full 60-minute hours in port-of-loading local time, and a declaration signed exactly at the deadline is accepted. The cargo cut-off relied on is the one recorded on the booking concerned. A declaration later than that deadline is not accepted for the sailing, the application stays submitted, and the shipper may withdraw it or move the booking under the booking product's own rules.

## Charging a late declaration
- The earlier clause under which "a late but accepted declaration is charged the late declaration fee once, referencing the late submission" is **no longer in force**; the moment and basis on which a late declaration is charged are governed by the current basis for the late declaration fee.
- A late declaration fee may be booked only while the acceptance is submitted or under review.
- A late submission is charged at most once.

## Boundary cases on the deadline (hypothetical 30-hour cut-off window)
Cargo cut-off of the sailing: 22 May at 16:00, port-of-loading local time. The deadline is 30 full hours earlier: 21 May at 10:00 local time.
| Declaration signed (port-of-loading local time) | Outcome |
|---|---|
| 21 May 09:59 | accepted for the sailing (as a late declaration, where it is also late) |
| 21 May 10:00 | accepted — signed exactly at the deadline |
| 21 May 10:01 | not accepted for the sailing; the application stays submitted |

## When a late declaration fee may be booked
| Acceptance status | Late declaration fee may be booked |
|---|---|
| submitted | yes |
| under review | yes |
| any other status | no |
